Special drawing rights.question: When the euro was introduced in January _____, it replaced the German mark and French franc and the basket consisted of four currencies
Special drawing rights.fact: When the euro was introduced in January 1999, it replaced the German mark and French franc and the basket consisted of four currencies.

Special drawing rights.question: In November _____, the IMF determined that China's renminbi met the export requirement but failed to meet the "freely usable" requirement and thus was not included in the XDR basket taking effect on 1
Special drawing rights.fact: In November 2010, the IMF determined that China's renminbi met the export requirement but failed to meet the "freely usable" requirement and thus was not included in the XDR basket taking effect on 1 January 2011.

Special drawing rights.subject: Business & Economy

Special drawing rights.fact: The effective date of the re-evaluation was postponed to 1 October 2016, in order to "allow users sufficient lead time to adjust". In 2016, the renminbi was added to the basket with a 10.9% weighting.

Special drawing rights.fact: The IMF sets the value of the XDR in terms of United States dollars every day. The latest United States dollar valuation of the XDR is published on the IMF website.

Special drawing rights.subject: Business & Economy

Special drawing rights.fact: The IMF sets the value of the XDR in terms of United States dollars every day. The latest United States dollar valuation of the XDR is published on the IMF website.

Special drawing rights.subject: Business & Economy
Special drawing rights.question: A country's IMF quota, the maximum amount of financial resources that it is obligated to contribute to the fund, determines its allotment of _____
Special drawing rights.fact: A country's IMF quota, the maximum amount of financial resources that it is obligated to contribute to the fund, determines its allotment of XDRs.

Special drawing rights.subject: Business & Economy
Special drawing rights.question: Creating a new allocation requires 85% of the votes in the SDR _____ of the IMF
Special drawing rights.fact: Creating a new allocation requires 85% of the votes in the SDR Department of the IMF. All IMF member countries are represented in the SDR Department, but this is not a one country, one vote system; voting power is determined by a member country's IMF quota.

Special drawing rights.subject: Business & Economy
Special drawing rights.question: All IMF member countries are represented in the SDR _____, but this is not a one country, one vote system; voting power is determined by a member country's IMF quota
Special drawing rights.fact: Creating a new allocation requires 85% of the votes in the SDR Department of the IMF. All IMF member countries are represented in the SDR Department, but this is not a one country, one vote system; voting power is determined by a member country's IMF quota.

Special drawing rights.fact: For example, the United States has 16.7% of the vote as of 2 March 2011.

Special drawing rights.question: This means the _____ has a de facto veto on all new XDR allocations, it is currently the only country that does
Special drawing rights.fact: For example, the United States has 16.7% of the vote as of 2 March 2011. This means the United States has a de facto veto on all new XDR allocations, it is currently the only country that does.
